name: AuxPair.exists_annihilator_or_congr_inclMatrix
summary: Make x primitive by a right factor b, write x b = P with an integral left inverse L, and take l = P L - 1, which kills x. If the iota-columns of l vanish mod w, then the iota-rows of P times the iota-columns of L are 1 mod w, so T = (iota-columns of L) is invertible over O_w and a = b T makes x a congruent to the inclusion matrix.

steps.claim: Since O_w is a valuation ring of E_w and x has a left inverse, there is b in GL_r(E_w) with x b primitive (integral, of full rank modulo w).
x b = P for an integral n x r matrix P with an integral left inverse L (L P = 1), so x = P b^(-1).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨P, ⟨L, e⟩, rfl⟩ := by simpa [← mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible] using
    h.exists_map_subtype_eq

steps.claim: Take l = P L - 1, an integral n x n matrix.
steps.lean:
use P * L - 1, (congr($Matrix.map_mul * _).trans (Matrix.mul_assoc ..)).symm.trans (by simp
    [e]), fun H ↦ (isUnit_of_mapMatrix _ (.of_mul_eq_one_right _ (ext
    (by simpa [mul_apply, funext_iff] using H <| ι ·)))).elim fun T e ↦ ⟨b * .map (algebraMap ..) T,
    by simpa [↓Matrix.mul_assoc, e, mul_apply] using!
    (residue_eq_iff_valuation_sub_lt_one.1 <| congrFun₂ (funext H) · ·)⟩

steps.claim: Suppose the entries of l in the columns iota(r) have zero residues (H). At the rows iota(r) this says that the iota-rows of P times the iota-columns of L are 1 modulo w; so the iota-columns of L form an r x r integral matrix T invertible over O_w.
steps.lean:
fun H ↦ (isUnit_of_mapMatrix _ (.of_mul_eq_one_right _ (ext
    (by simpa [mul_apply, funext_iff] using H <| ι ·)))).elim

steps.claim: Take a = b T. Then x a = P T, whose (c, k) entry is (P L)_{c, iota(k)}, congruent modulo w to the (c, iota(k)) entry of the identity by H, that is to inclMatrix(O_w, iota)_{c,k}; so the difference has valuation < 1.
steps.lean:
fun T e ↦ ⟨b * .map (algebraMap ..) T,
    by simpa [↓Matrix.mul_assoc, e, mul_apply] using!
    (residue_eq_iff_valuation_sub_lt_one.1 <| congrFun₂ (funext H) · ·)⟩
